scenes.text: A massive star does not simply die.
It collapses, then explodes, then collapses again.
The first death is silent. The second one outshines a galaxy.
For a few weeks, it is brighter than every star in the sky combined.
Then it leaves behind a single spoonful weighing a billion tonnes.
